categories.name: aurix-tc3x
categories.description: Infineon AURIX TC3x multicore ECU deployment and test bench blocks

customDescriptions.value: Simulate the ADC peripheral behavior for test bench testing — use in SIL/PIL to provide analog input stimulus without hardware
Device-specific library container for Infineon AURIX TC3x multicore processors — provides access to TC3x-specific peripherals and scheduling
Simulate digital I/O peripheral behavior for test bench testing — use in SIL/PIL to provide GPIO stimulus without hardware
Generate scheduling events for test bench simulation — use to trigger task execution in SIL/PIL without real hardware timer interrupts
Simulate inter-core communication channels for test bench testing — use in SIL/PIL to model data exchange between cores without real shared memory
Read shared data from another AURIX TC3x core — use for inter-core communication in multicore automotive ECU deployments
Write shared data visible to other AURIX TC3x cores — use for inter-core data exchange in multicore deployments
Simulate PWM peripheral behavior for test bench testing — use in SIL/PIL to capture PWM duty cycle outputs without hardware
Configure multi-core task scheduling on the AURIX TC3x — use to assign Simulink subsystems to specific cores and manage execution priority
Utility blocks for AURIX TC3x deployment — use for target-specific configuration and diagnostics
